description: Reference knowledge graph used by the Knowledge Analysis Agent to resolve mastery at exact concept level, sequence gaps via prerequisites, and hand precise learning-material hints to the Learning Generator / Content agents. Concept nodes carry signal_patterns that map raw error/evidence text (review findings, sandbox errors, quiz misses) to the specific Java concept the student struggles with.

CS101-VAR.label: Variables
CS101-VAR.description: Declaring, initializing and assigning primitive/reference variables.

concepts.label: variable declaration and assignment
concepts.focus: Review data types, declaration syntax and assignment semantics.
concepts.misconception: declares variables without initializing them before use

concepts.label: variable scope and shadowing
concepts.focus: Practice block scope, shadowing and variable lifetimes.
concepts.misconception: expects a block-scoped variable to be visible outside its block

CS101-TYPES.label: Types & Operators
CS101-TYPES.description: Primitive types, wrappers, type conversion and operators.

concepts.label: type conversion and casting
concepts.focus: Practice implicit vs explicit casts and overflow behaviour.
concepts.misconception: assumes division always yields a fractional result

concepts.label: if-else and switch logic
concepts.focus: Trace branch coverage and chained conditions.
concepts.misconception: misorders conditions so later branches are unreachable

concepts.label: null-safe conditionals
concepts.focus: Guard against null references before dereferencing.
concepts.misconception: forgets null checks on method return values

CS101-LOOP.label: Loops
CS101-LOOP.description: for, while and do-while loops including nesting and boundaries.

concepts.label: basic loop syntax
concepts.focus: Review for/while loop structure and counter updates.
concepts.misconception: confuses loop initialization, condition, and update order

concepts.label: nested loops
concepts.focus: Use row-column tracing and dry-run tables.
concepts.misconception: does not trace inner loop execution correctly

concepts.label: loop boundary conditions
concepts.focus: Practice start/end values and inclusive versus exclusive bounds.
concepts.misconception: uses incorrect loop termination boundaries

CS101-ARR.label: Arrays
CS101-ARR.description: Array indexing, traversal and bounds handling.

concepts.label: array indexing
concepts.focus: Practice zero-based indexing and valid index ranges.
concepts.misconception: confuses array length with the last valid index

concepts.label: array traversal
concepts.focus: Trace arrays with loop counters and bounds.
concepts.misconception: skips or repeats elements while traversing arrays

CS101-ITER.label: Iteration Patterns
CS101-ITER.description: Accumulators, searching and transform loops over collections of values.

concepts.label: accumulator and aggregate loops
concepts.focus: Practice sum/count/min/max accumulation invariants.
concepts.misconception: resets the accumulator inside the loop body

concepts.label: linear search
concepts.focus: Track found-flag/early-return patterns.
concepts.misconception: does not break or return once the target is found

CS101-FUNC.label: Methods & Functions
CS101-FUNC.description: Method signatures, parameters, return values and overloading.

concepts.label: method signature and return values
concepts.focus: Practice defining clear parameters and return contracts.
concepts.misconception: returns wrong type or forgets the return path

concepts.label: method overloading
concepts.focus: Compare overloads resolved at compile time.
concepts.misconception: confuses overloading with overriding

CS101-STACK.label: Call Stack
CS101-STACK.description: How method calls, frames and returns work at runtime.

concepts.label: stack frame tracing
concepts.focus: Trace frames, locals and return addresses for nested calls.
concepts.misconception: cannot explain how nested calls unwind

CS201-CLASS.label: Classes & Objects
CS201-CLASS.description: Class fields, constructors, objects and state.

concepts.label: class design and state
concepts.focus: Separate fields, constructors, and methods clearly.
concepts.misconception: mixes object state with local method variables

concepts.label: constructor chaining
concepts.focus: Practice super() calls and parent initialization order.
concepts.misconception: does not understand when parent constructors run

CS201-OOP.label: OOP & Class Design
CS201-OOP.description: Encapsulation, object design and polymorphism foundations.

concepts.label: class design
concepts.focus: Separate fields, constructors, and methods clearly.
concepts.misconception: mixes object state with local method variables

concepts.label: polymorphism
concepts.focus: Practice dynamic dispatch and overriding behaviour.
concepts.misconception: expects static type methods at runtime

CS201-INH.label: OOP - Inheritance
CS201-INH.description: Class hierarchies, super calls and overriding.

concepts.label: constructor chaining
concepts.focus: Practice super() calls and parent initialization order.
concepts.misconception: does not understand when parent constructors run

concepts.label: method overriding
concepts.focus: Compare overriding with overloading through small examples.
concepts.misconception: confuses overriding with overloading

CS201-POLY.label: Polymorphism
CS201-POLY.description: Dynamic dispatch across an inheritance hierarchy.

concepts.label: dynamic dispatch
concepts.focus: Trace which overridden method runs for each runtime type.
concepts.misconception: binds calls to the static type instead of the runtime type

CS201-IFACE.label: Interfaces & Abstraction
CS201-IFACE.description: Interface contracts and programming to abstractions.

concepts.label: interface design
concepts.focus: Define small, cohesive interfaces that capture one role.
concepts.misconception: creates interfaces without a clear single responsibility

concepts.label: programming to abstractions
concepts.focus: Depend on interfaces rather than concrete classes.
concepts.misconception: couples callers to concrete implementations

concepts.label: checked versus unchecked exceptions
concepts.focus: Compare compile-time handling requirements.
concepts.misconception: confuses checked and unchecked exception rules

concepts.label: try-catch-finally control flow
concepts.focus: Trace execution through try, catch, and finally blocks.
concepts.misconception: does not predict which block executes after an exception

CS102-FILE.label: File I/O & Resources
CS102-FILE.description: Reading/writing files and managing resources safely.

concepts.label: file read/write flow
concepts.focus: Practice opening, reading/writing, and closing resources.
concepts.misconception: does not manage resources across success and failure paths

concepts.label: file exception handling
concepts.focus: Handle missing files and permission failures explicitly.
concepts.misconception: ignores file operation failure modes

concepts.label: stream chaining and flushing
concepts.focus: Close streams in the right order and flush buffers.
concepts.misconception: loses data because the stream is never flushed or closed

concepts.label: serializable contracts
concepts.focus: Declare SerialVersionUID and handle transient fields.
concepts.misconception: ignores serialization versioning and transient state

CS201-DS.label: Collections & Data Structures
CS201-DS.description: Lists, maps, sets, generics and the Collections framework.

concepts.label: data structure selection
concepts.focus: Compare lists, maps, sets, and trees by operation.
concepts.misconception: chooses structures without considering access patterns

concepts.label: operation complexity
concepts.focus: Connect common operations to time complexity.
concepts.misconception: does not connect operations to performance cost

CS101-REC.label: Recursion
CS101-REC.description: Base cases, stack frames and recursive result composition.

concepts.label: base case identification
concepts.focus: Practice identifying stopping conditions before writing code.
concepts.misconception: treats the base case as optional or secondary

concepts.label: stack frame tracing
concepts.focus: Trace call frames, return values, and recursion depth.
concepts.misconception: cannot explain how recursive calls return

concepts.label: recursive return composition
concepts.focus: Practice combining recursive results correctly.
concepts.misconception: loses return values across recursive calls

CS201-TREE.label: Trees
CS201-TREE.description: Tree structure, nodes and traversal foundations.

concepts.label: tree structure and node references
concepts.focus: Trace parent/child links and recursive definitions.
concepts.misconception: confuses node objects with their values

concepts.label: tree traversal
concepts.focus: Trace depth-first traversal recursion.
concepts.misconception: handles null child subtrees incorrectly

CS201-BST.label: Binary Search Trees
CS201-BST.description: BST invariants, search/insert and deletion cases.

concepts.label: BST insertion and search
concepts.focus: Trace comparisons from root to leaf.
concepts.misconception: does not preserve the left-less/right-greater invariant

concepts.label: BST deletion cases
concepts.focus: Practice leaf, one-child, and two-child deletion separately.
concepts.misconception: cannot handle deletion for nodes with two children

concepts.label: tree traversal order
concepts.focus: Trace inorder, preorder, and postorder outputs.
concepts.misconception: confuses traversal order and output sequence

concepts.label: equals and hashCode contract
concepts.focus: Keep equals/hashCode consistent for map keys.
concepts.misconception: breaks map lookups by overriding equals without hashCode

concepts.label: algorithm tracing
concepts.focus: Dry-run algorithm state step by step.
concepts.misconception: jumps to final answers without tracing state changes

concepts.label: complexity reasoning
concepts.focus: Estimate time complexity from loops and recursive calls.
concepts.misconception: counts statements without understanding growth rate

CS301-CONC.label: Concurrency & Threads
CS301-CONC.description: Thread safety, synchronization and coordination primitives.

concepts.label: thread safety
concepts.focus: Guard shared mutable state with synchronization or immutability.
concepts.misconception: assumes shared state is safe without synchronization

concepts.label: coordination primitives
concepts.focus: Practice locks, executors, and atomic operations on small examples.
concepts.misconception: uses raw threads without understanding coordination

CS301-PERF.label: Performance
CS301-PERF.description: Avoiding unnecessary work and hot-path costs.

concepts.label: hot-path optimisation
concepts.focus: Profile before optimising; avoid repeated allocations.
concepts.misconception: optimises without evidence from profiling

concepts.label: test coverage
concepts.focus: Add unit tests for core paths and edge cases.
concepts.misconception: treats manual runs as sufficient verification

concepts.label: assertion design
concepts.focus: Write focused assertions that pin down expected behaviour.
concepts.misconception: writes tests without meaningful assertions

CS101-DEBUG.label: Debugging
CS101-DEBUG.description: Systematic debugging using traces and breakpoints.

concepts.label: systematic tracing
concepts.focus: Reproduce, isolate, and fix failures incrementally.
concepts.misconception: guesses at fixes without reproducing the failure

concepts.label: naming and conventions
concepts.focus: Use descriptive names and consistent conventions.
concepts.misconception: uses unclear or inconsistent names

concepts.label: readable structure
concepts.focus: Keep methods short and avoid magic numbers.
concepts.misconception: writes long methods with unexplained constants

concepts.label: secret management
concepts.focus: Keep secrets out of source control; use env vars and ignore files.
concepts.misconception: commits credentials or .env files to the repository

concepts.label: repository hygiene
concepts.focus: Ignore dependencies and build artifacts via .gitignore.
concepts.misconception: commits build output instead of ignoring them

SE-VALID.label: Input Validation & Robustness
SE-VALID.description: Validating input and handling edge cases.

concepts.label: input validation
concepts.focus: Validate and reject bad input before using it.
concepts.misconception: trusts external input without checks

concepts.label: edge-case handling
concepts.focus: Enumerate boundary and empty cases explicitly.
concepts.misconception: handles only the happy path

SE-ARCH.label: API & Architecture Design
SE-ARCH.description: Layering, separation of concerns and dependency management.

concepts.label: separation of concerns
concepts.focus: Split responsibilities across cohesive components.
concepts.misconception: mixes unrelated concerns in one class

concepts.label: dependency management
concepts.focus: Reduce coupling by depending on abstractions.
concepts.misconception: hard-wires dependencies between layers

CS-GEN.label: General Code Quality
CS-GEN.description: Fallback bucket for general code-quality findings.

concepts.label: core concept application
concepts.focus: Review the flagged concept with small traceable examples.
concepts.misconception: cannot reliably apply the concept independently
